howItWorks.title: AI Reads and Explains. Rules and Verifiers Decide.
howItWorks.subtitle: ScamLens is engineered around transparent, auditable principles. We never rely on a 'black box' AI to guess whether something is safe or a scam.
howItWorks.step1Desc: Screenshots and text payloads are loaded strictly into RAM buffers. No files are written to disk, and no databases persist user inputs.
howItWorks.step2Desc: The vision-language model acts purely as an objective reader: extracting verbatim text, brand signatures, contact numbers, and visual anomalies. It is strictly forbidden from assigning risk scores.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Extracted URLs and domains are independently verified against threat databases (Google Safe Browsing, URLhaus) and RDAP domain registration age to catch typosquatted domains registered days ago.
howItWorks.step4Desc: Transparent YAML rule packs score the extracted facts across 10 distinct fraud vectors. Every red flag must quote exact verbatim words from the input.
howItWorks.step5Desc: Synthesizes the deterministic findings into plain, parent-friendly English, Tamil, or Hindi, complete with an actionable, shareable Family Alert card for WhatsApp.
howItWorks.philosophyTitle: Why ScamLens Doesn't Use End-to-End AI Scoring
howItWorks.philosophySubtitle: Pure LLM detectors hallucinate, can be easily bypassed by prompt injection, and give confident false assurances. ScamLens fixes this by separating perceptual reading from deterministic judgment.
howItWorks.pillar1Desc: Every single point in the risk score maps to an explicit rule in open-source YAML files and quotes verbatim evidence.
howItWorks.pillar2Desc: Prompt injection attempts inside suspicious images or text cannot manipulate the final verdict score computed by deterministic rules.
howItWorks.pillar3Desc: Uploaded media is processed in volatile memory and purged immediately. ScamLens stores zero user data or telemetry.
howItWorks.bottomBannerDesc: Try our interactive analyzer with sample documents or upload your own suspicious message.

benchmarks.title: Performance & Precision Metrics
benchmarks.subtitle: ScamLens is tested against synthetic fraud cases and genuine transactional notifications to measure detection precision and zero false-positive rates.
benchmarks.confusionMatrixDesc: Results across evaluated sample suites, measuring verified scam detection and safe message preservation.
benchmarks.comparisonTitle: Hybrid Pipeline vs. Pure LLM Architecture
benchmarks.comparisonDesc: Comparison of detection recall and hallucination rates between pure LLM analysis and ScamLens's hybrid architecture.
benchmarks.comparisonExplanationText: Pure LLMs frequently fail when encountering novel URL typosquatting or urgency phrasing, whereas deterministic YAML rules paired with live RDAP age checks catch scam domains within minutes of creation.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy & Architecture
privacy.subtitle: A transparent explanation of how ScamLens handles your screenshots, what is sent where, and how you retain complete control.
privacy.policy1Desc: Uploaded images and pasted texts are processed exclusively in volatile memory (RAM). ScamLens has no database, no file server, and no cloud object buckets. All buffer bytes are released the moment the HTTP response finishes.
privacy.policy2Desc: ScamLens requires no login, no email address, and no personal profile. We store no session cookies and build no behavioral user graph.
privacy.policy3Desc: Neither your screenshots nor your extracted messages are used to train, tune, or evaluate AI models under any circumstances.
privacy.policy4Desc: For highly sensitive financial files, switch to 'Private, local' mode powered by a local Ollama server. Not a single byte leaves your computer.
privacy.comparisonTitle: Cloud Mode vs. Local Mode Privacy Comparison
privacy.cloudDataTransmission: HTTPS encrypted to cloud vision API with zero data retention
privacy.localDataTransmission: Zero network calls; entirely confined to localhost
privacy.bothNoStorage: None. Held in ephemeral RAM during inference only
privacy.cloudVerifiers: Domain age and Google Safe Browsing checks via DNS/HTTPS
privacy.localVerifiers: Disabled or restricted to offline brand matching heuristics
privacy.localModelInference: Self-hosted local Gemma 4 model via Ollama
privacy.guaranteeBoxDesc: Every line of ScamLens backend code and pipeline orchestration is open source. You can run ScamLens in Docker on your own machine without sending a single byte over the Internet.

about.title: About ScamLens
about.subtitle: An open, explainable fraud detection initiative built for families, everyday users, and digital safety researchers.
about.comparisonHeader: How ScamLens Compares to Existing Tools
about.comparisonSub: Why transparent, evidence-based red flags matter more than proprietary black boxes.
about.missionDesc: Digital fraud is disproportionately targeting families, seniors, and students in non-English communities. We believe people deserve tools that don't just give an opaque 'danger' or 'safe' label, but patiently explain the deceptive tactics used in their own language.
about.communityDesc: Help us improve detection accuracy by submitting new YAML rule patterns, translating explanation templates, or adding live verification checks.
